sam3.ptx

Hand-written PTX kernels for SAM 3 (Segment Anything 3) image inference with a text prompt: find every instance of a noun phrase in an image and return its box, score and mask. The whole file, as the engine loads it: each kernel and device function in a card with its parameters, resources and cross references, then its code. Every label, parameter, array and function name links to its definition; hover a register to see each of its uses in that function, click it to keep them marked.

module directives

lines 1–38
sam3.ptx - hand-written PTX kernels for SAM 3 (Segment Anything 3) image inference with a text prompt: find every instance of a noun phrase in an image and return its box, score and mask. The host (sam3.c) runs, for a 1008 x 1008 image (72 x 72 patches of 14): vision backbone (ViT-L, 32 blocks, width 1024, 16 heads of 64): x = patch_embed(img) + tiled pos_embed, ln_pre im2col_patch, gemm_f16, add_pos, layernorm per block: x += proj(attn(rope2d(qkv(LN(x))))) layernorm, gemm_f16, x += fc2(gelu(fc1(LN(x)))) rope_vit, flash_attn attention in 24 x 24 windows, global in blocks 7, 15, 23, 31 neck (SimpleFPN): 72^2 x 1024 -> 288^2, 144^2, 72^2 x 256 gemm_f16 (deconv, 1x1), depth2space, im2col3 text encoder (CLIP, 24 blocks, width 1024, causal, 32 tokens) -> 256 geometry encoder: one CLS token, 3 layers attending to the image fusion encoder (6 layers, 256 wide, 8 heads of 32): image tokens attend to each other and to the prompt (text + CLS) split_heads, flash_attn decoder (6 layers, 200 queries + 1 presence token): self attention, text cross attention, image cross attention with a box relative position bias, box refinement after every layer box_sine, rpb_mlp, box_update scoring: dot product of each query with the pooled prompt masked_mean, linear_small masks: pixel decoder (upsample + conv3x3 + GroupNorm + ReLU twice) and mask = (MLP(query)) . (1x1 conv(pixels)) at 288 x 288 upsample_add, im2col3, gn_stats, gn_apply masks of the kept queries resized to the image mask_resize Weights are converted to f16 at load (f32_to_f16); every matrix product is an f16 tensor-core mma with f32 accumulation (gemm_f16, flash_attn). The residual streams, norms, softmax statistics and small heads stay f32. Activations are row-major [tokens][channels] (a feature map is [y][x][c]).

layernorm

lines 48–206
Kernel: layernorm y = (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps) * w + b, per row One warp per row of n values (n % 128 == 0), 8 rows per 256-thread block. Outputs (each optional, 0 = skip): y32 f32 (may be x itself), y16 f16, yp16 f16 = y + pos (pos f32 [rows][n]; the "query + position" input of an attention layer). grid ceil(rows / 8), block 256.

add_pos

lines 214–269
Kernel: add_pos x[t][c] += pos[1 + (y % ps) * ps + (x % ps)][c] The ViT's absolute position embedding was trained for 24 x 24 patches (+ a class token, row 0); at 72 x 72 it is tiled 3 x 3, not interpolated. t = y * gw + x. Grid-stride over the n = T * C / 4 float4s.

im2col_patch

lines 278–355
Kernel: im2col_patch the patch-embedding convolution (p x p, stride p, no bias) as a matrix: row t of dst = the p x p x C pixels of patch t in (ky, kx, c) order (the weight's layout), zero-padded to kpad columns. img f32 [side][side][C] (normalized), dst f16 [T][kpad], T = gw * gw. One thread per pair of columns, grid-stride.

gemm_f16

lines 471–806
Kernel: gemm_f16 C[M][N] = A[M][K] . B[N][K]^T + bias, with an epilogue A: f16 activations [M][K] (rows readable up to M rounded up to 128), B: f16 weights [N][K] (a PyTorch Linear weight as stored), bias f32 [N] or 0. Needs N % 128 == 0 and K % 32 == 0. Block tile 128 x 128, k-tile 32; 256 threads = 8 warps as 2 (rows) x 4 (cols), each warp 64 x 32 = 4 x 4 mma.m16n8k16 tiles (f16 in, f32 acc). Tiles go global -> shared with cp.async in a 3-stage ring (two k-tiles in flight while one is computed) and shared -> registers with ldmatrix. Shared rows are 64 bytes (4 chunks of 8 halves); chunk c of row r is stored at chunk c ^ ((r >> 1) & 3) so that the 8 row addresses of every ldmatrix phase hit 8 different 16-byte bank groups. mode (the epilogue, per pair of adjacent outputs v = acc + bias): 0 C f32 = v 1 C f16 = v 2 C f16 = gelu(v) 3 C f16 = relu(v) 4 C f32 += v (residual add) grid (N / 128, ceil(M / 128)), block 256. C row stride ldc (elements).

rope_vit

lines 820–928
Kernel: rope_vit splits the ViT's qkv [T][3C] (q | k | v, head h at columns h*64 .. +64 of each) into per-head f16 Q, K, V [BH][L][64] and rotates q and k with the 2-D axial RoPE: pair j (dims 2j, 2j+1) turns by x * freq_j for j < 16 and by y * freq_(j-16) for j >= 16, freq_i = 10000^(-i/16), where (x, y) is the token's column and row: inside its 24 x 24 window for windowed blocks (L = 576, BH = 9 windows x 16 heads), over the whole 72 x 72 grid for global blocks (L = 5184, BH = 16), there scaled by 24/72 (the grid the model was trained with). The host passes the matching cos/sin table cs [L][32][2]. One thread per (token, head, pair), grid-stride.

Function: mask_score one attention score of flash_attn's general path: s * scale * log2(e), then -inf for a padding key (key >= lk), a masked key (flags 1), a future key (flags 2); plus the box bias (flags 4) of query q (clamped to lq - 1: rows past lq are computed but never stored).

flash_attn

lines 1108–1819
Kernel: flash_attn O = softmax(Q K^T * scale + bias) V, one (batch x head) per blockIdx.y, 64 query rows per block (4 warps x 16 rows), 64-dim heads (smaller heads are zero-padded to 64 by split_heads; padding adds 0 to every score and its output columns are not stored). Q [BH][lq_pad][64], K and V [BH][lk_pad][64], f16, rows padded to a multiple of 64 (padding keys are masked by index). Key tiles of 64 go to shared memory with cp.async (two buffers: the next tile loads while this one is used); S = Q K^T and O += P V are mma.m16n8k16 (f16 in, f32 acc), and the softmax is the online one (running row max m and sum l, in base 2: scores are multiplied by scale * log2(e) and exponentiated with ex2). P never leaves registers: the S accumulator of two adjacent 8-key tiles is exactly the A fragment of a 16-key mma step. flags: 1 key mask (kmask u8 [Lk], 1 = ignore the key), 2 causal (key <= query), 4 box bias (the decoder's relative position bias, separable over the bgw x bgw grid of keys: + by[h][q][key / bgw] + bx[h][q][key % bgw], f32 [H][Lq][bgw]). Output row of query q: q, or with windows (wsz > 0) the token of window b = bh / H at (q / wsz, q % wsz) of a grid gw wide with nwx windows per row. O f16 [tokens][ostride], head h at columns h*dout .. +dout. grid (lq_pad / 64, BH), block 128.

rpb_mlp

lines 2481–2606
Kernel: rpb_mlp the decoder's box relative position bias ("boxRPB log"): for query q's box (x0, y0, x1, y1) and key column i of the 72 x 72 grid (coordinate i / 72), the deltas d = (i/72 - x0, i/72 - x1) are squashed to sign(8d) log2(|8d| + 1) / 3 and mapped by an MLP 2 -> 256 (relu) -> 8 to one bias per head; rows likewise with y. flash_attn adds by[h][q][row] + bx[h][q][column] to the score of a key. One thread per (query, axis, i); query q writes row q + 1 of the outputs (row 0 is the presence token: no bias, left zero).
